case.question: What are the main risks of investing in Indian EV battery startups in 2026?
must_contain_claims: cell manufacturing capacity in India is still small relative to demand
dependence on imported lithium and imported cell components
policy and subsidy dependence (PLI scheme exposure)
price competition from Chinese cell manufacturers
forbidden_claims: India has no domestic cell manufacturing
lithium-ion cell prices rose every year through 2026
case.notes: The briefing's own worked example. Keep it as case one — it is what the judges saw.

case.question: How has the levelised cost of grid-scale battery storage moved since 2023, and why?

case.question: Is sodium-ion battery technology commercially deployed at scale yet?

case.question: What does our uploaded market assessment say about cell supply risk?
must_contain_claims: the supply-risk conclusion as the document states it
the document's own caveat or confidence language
case.notes: Answerable ONLY from the uploaded file. Scores retrieval.corpus_only_rate: any web citation here is a failure, not a bonus. Needs a real fixture PDF committed before this case runs.

case.question: What 2027 revenue projection does our market assessment give?
must_contain_claims: the document does not contain a 2027 revenue projection
case.notes: Corpus case that is also an abstain case: the honest answer is that the document is silent. Catches the system filling the gap from the web and citing it as if it were the document.

case.question: How large is the Indian stationary battery storage market?
case.conflicting_on: total market size estimate — published figures differ by several times depending on scope and year
must_contain_claims: more than one estimate, each attributed to its source
an explicit statement that the estimates disagree
why they disagree (scope, base year, or methodology)
case.notes: Scores verify.conflict_surfaced_rate. Silently picking the largest number is the failure we are measuring.

case.question: What were Indian EV battery sector revenues in calendar year 2028?
case.notes: Future date. Correct output is 'insufficient evidence', optionally with forecasts clearly labelled as forecasts. A confident historical figure here is the single worst result in the suite.

cases.report:

notes: The headline fixture for this track. A hand-written 10-claim draft fed straight to the
verifier, bypassing planner, researcher and drafter.
Build it so each false claim fails differently:
c3  number contradicts its own cited passage
c5  citation points to a real retrieved source that never mentions the claim
c8  citation URL was never in the retrieval set at all
c9  true statement, wrong attribution (right fact, wrong source)
Scores verify.poison_recall (gate) and verify.poison_precision. The six true claims are
what stops a reject-everything verifier from scoring 1.0.
